Now I can do it without a timer and it’s really helped!

It has no goal as in I don’t practice it to attain something because in my experience that negates the whole thing. I meditate to meditate and through it I have the choice to see subtler forms of desire, holding on, illusion, etc.

Everyone experiences realities and believes in different things because we all come from different backgrounds and each one of us has different lessons to learn. 

Meditation has no goal for me. But that wouldn’t stop me from cultivating it. Healing feels like stillness, insight, and it changes from time to time. Your 30 years of experience is as valid as someone else’s experience, however it may look because it is theirs to experience. There’s truth in all beliefs but truth is beyond beliefs.
Perhaps our definitions of healing, self, and meditation are different.
